## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.1.1

Profiler-only configuration fix for Bannerlord v1.3.15 and The Old Realms v1.16.

### Fixed

- Fixed the packaged `ModuleData/BannerlordCpuOptimizer/settings.json` being ignored at runtime.
- The packaged module settings file is now loaded when present.
- The Documents configuration remains a fallback when the packaged settings file is missing.
- Startup logs now print the exact settings path and the effective profiler flags.

### Safety boundary

This remains a profiler-only release. It adds no gameplay optimization patches, AI throttling, simulation throttling, transpilers, background TaleWorlds access, or serialized optimizer state.
